STASH HOUSE UNCOVERED!
On 6/9, USBP agents and ICE @EROElPaso disrupted a human smuggling operation inside an El Paso, TX apartment. At the center of it all—a Mexican national unlawfully in the U.S. He first denied involvement, but later admitted to being the caretaker of the stash house.

He now faces charges for:
❌ Conspiracy to harbor illegal aliens
❌ Making false statements to a federal agent
❌ Felony illegal re-entry

Agents apprehended 8 illegal aliens at the scene. All will be processed and charged under U.S. immigration law.

No hiding. No escaping. The law will find you.

MS-13 GANG MEMBER ARRESTED!
On Sunday, USBP agents arrested Delmar Sanchez-Zuniga, a Honduran national, after he tried to sneak into the U.S. by hiding in a sugar cane field near Eagle Pass, TX.

Agents quickly ran his records and uncovered a violent criminal past:
❌ MS-13 gang member
❌Felony convictions for possession of a controlled substance
❌Felony conviction for possession of defaced firearm
❌Arrest for sexual assault
❌Arrest for aggravated assault

He now faces prosecution for felony illegal re-entry (8USC1326).

Gang ties. Violent past. No place in the U.S.
